name: Sewer Pipe Trap AP
description: Pressure-sensitive panels in the floor connects to a metal plate holding a number of sewer pipes shut in the ceiling.
disable: DC 32 Thievery (expert) on the floor panels before the plate falls away

offensiveAbilities.name: Filth Fall
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Pressure is placed on the floor tiles

Effect The metal plate above gives way, unleashing a torrent of sewage and flesh-eating worms on everyone within 10 feet of the pressure plate. Anyone hit by the filth must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes Sickened 1 and takes 2d12 Piercing Damage damage.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2 and takes 4d12 Piercing Damage damage.

Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 4 and takes 4d12 Piercing Damage damage plus 2d12 Persistent,piercing Damage damage.
